summary: Infinity22 is a Melbourne-headquartered cloud accounting and virtual CFO firm that started in eCommerce and now describes itself as a multidisciplinary advisory practice. Founder and CEO Thomas Sparks says the firm is building a Financial Operating System for SMEs with AI-enabled finance systems layered over Xero. It was hiring a senior R&D tax specialist in September 2026.

hooks.text: Thomas's own Financial Operating System / AI-over-Xero framing: reconciliation is the unglamorous layer that has to be trusted for that to work.
Xero plus A2X and Dear Inventory stack means payout and inventory reconciliations recur monthly across eCommerce clients.
Active hiring (senior R&D tax role) shows capacity pressure on specialist time.

risks.text: Thomas already positions Infinity22 around AI-enabled finance systems, so he may build or buy his own automation.

gaps: No Infinity22 posts found specifically about reconciliation pain; no recent Xero partner tier confirmed.
